munnar.climate: Cool year-round; roughly 10–25 °C. Heavy south-west monsoon June–August.
munnar.summary: Cool, clear days from September to March make it ideal for sightseeing and treks.

wayanad.summary: October to May is dry and pleasant; the monsoon makes trails slippery and some sites close.

thiruvananthapuram.climate: Tropical; roughly 23–33 °C. Two monsoons (June–Sept and Oct–Nov).
thiruvananthapuram.summary: October to March brings calmer seas, lower humidity and the best beach weather.

kochi.summary: October to March brings calmer seas, lower humidity and the best beach weather.

alappuzha.summary: November to February is ideal for houseboats; August hosts the famous snake boat races.

ooty.climate: Cool; roughly 5–22 °C, frost possible in winter.
ooty.summary: April–June is peak summer season; October–February is cooler and quieter.

kodaikanal.summary: Cool, clear days from September to March make it ideal for sightseeing and treks.

coorg.summary: Cool, clear days from September to March make it ideal for sightseeing and treks.

mysuru.summary: October to March is pleasant; the Dasara festival usually falls in September–October.

hampi.summary: October to February is best; summer temperatures among the boulders are extreme.

chikmagalur.summary: Cool, clear days from September to March make it ideal for sightseeing and treks.

goa.summary: November to February is peak beach season; the monsoon (June–September) is lush but many shacks close.

manali.summary: March–June for pleasant weather and adventure; December–February for snow.

jaipur.summary: October to March offers mild days — perfect for forts, palaces and markets.

udaipur.summary: October to March offers mild days — perfect for forts, palaces and markets.

ladakh.climate: Cold desert; summer days 15–25 °C, winters far below 0 °C.
ladakh.summary: May to September, when roads are open. Winters are extremely cold.

rishikesh.summary: September–November and February–May; rafting usually pauses during the monsoon.

lonavala.summary: June to September is the green, waterfall season; October–February is pleasant and dry.

kutch.summary: November to February, when the Rann is dry and the Rann Utsav festival is usually held.

darjeeling.summary: March–May and October–December for clear views of the Himalaya.

kyoto.climate: Humid subtropical; hot summers, cold winters.
kyoto.summary: Cherry blossoms in spring and autumn foliage in November; summers are hot and humid.

ubud.summary: April to October is the dry season; November to March brings heavy tropical showers.

cairo.climate: Hot desert; very hot summers, mild winters.
cairo.summary: Coolest and most comfortable from October to April; summer afternoons are very hot.

giza.climate: Hot desert; very hot summers, mild winters.
giza.summary: Best from October to April, when cooler months make outdoor sightseeing comfortable; summer midday heat is harsh.

luxor.climate: Hot desert; among Egypt's hottest cities in summer, with mild sunny winters.
luxor.summary: October to April is ideal for the open-air temples and tombs; summer heat often exceeds 40°C.
